definitions.explanation: Lacking any flavor, charm, or emotional appeal; tediously uninteresting.

examples.japanese: {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧。
⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧だった。
examples.english: The report had dry, uninteresting content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧こと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返し：10320_kurikaeshi⟧で、{無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Every day is the same thing repeated, and I'm living a dull, colorless life.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) meaning literally 'without flavor and dried out.' Used figuratively — never literally about food. Describes writing, speeches, daily life, or anything that lacks emotional richness or interest. Used as a na-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a dull, uneventful life
- {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: a dry, boring talk
- {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: a bland explanation
- {無味乾燥|むみかんそう}な⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧: tedious days

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦つまらない→つまらない：00590_tsumaranai⟧: boring; uninteresting — everyday word; broader in application
- ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧: boredom; tedium — focuses on the feeling of being bored rather than a quality of the thing itself
- ⟦{味気|あじけ}ない→味気ない：21055_ajikenai⟧: dull; flat; dreary — similar literary register; implies a lack of warmth or emotional nourishment
- ⟦{単調|たんちょう}→単調：11832_tanchou⟧: monotonous — emphasizes repetitiveness rather than lack of substance
